title: Olivia Hadjerioua
metaTitle: Olivia Hadjerioua — Executive Director | Dallas Detox Center
metaDescription: Meet Olivia Hadjerioua, Executive Director at Dallas Detox Center.
paragraphs: Olivia Hadjerioua serves as Executive Director for Dallas Detox Center and Fort Worth Wellness Center, where she oversees daily operations across both Texas facilities while supporting initiatives centered on quality care, team development, and client success.

Originally from Tennessee, Olivia brings a compassionate, people-centered approach to leadership rooted in her clinical background as a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC). With experience working across all levels of care, she is deeply passionate about helping individuals navigate mental health and substance use recovery with dignity, support, and hope.

In her leadership role, Olivia is committed to fostering a culture of accountability, integrity, and excellence while creating an environment where both clients and staff can thrive. Her dedication to operational excellence and individualized care continues to support the growth and mission of both Dallas Detox Center and Fort Worth Wellness Center.

title: Deborah Wade, BSN, RN
metaTitle: Deborah Wade, BSN, RN — Director of Nursing | Dallas Detox Center
metaDescription: Meet Deborah Wade, BSN, RN, Director of Nursing at Dallas Detox Center.
paragraphs: Deborah has been a dedicated member of the Dallas Detox Center team for the past three years. With a strong passion for client care and recovery, Deborah plays a vital role in medically supporting clients through the detoxification process. She also manages client care at the Residential Treatment Center (RTC) level of care and provides leadership and oversight to the nursing staff. Her compassionate approach and clinical expertise help ensure a safe, supportive environment for clients at every stage of their recovery journey.

title: Joshua Leder
metaTitle: Joshua Leder — Director of Operations | Dallas Detox Center
metaDescription: Meet Joshua Leder, Director of Operations at Dallas Detox Center.
paragraphs: Joshua Leder serves as Director of Operations for the Texas facilities under Quadrant Health Group, where he oversees daily operations and supports the continued growth and development of the organization’s behavioral health programs across the state.

Originally born in Colorado and raised primarily in Texas, Joshua brings both personal passion and professional dedication to his role. As a proud father of two children, he values family, purpose, and creating a positive impact in the lives of others.

Joshua is deeply committed to helping individuals build healthier, more fulfilling lives while encouraging hope, healing, and personal growth. Guided by compassion, understanding, and faith, he strives to support others in recognizing that lasting change and recovery are possible. Drawing from his own experiences and journey, Joshua is passionate about inspiring those around him through strength, empathy, and service to others.

title: Haley Wadlington
metaTitle: Haley Wadlington — Director of Client Care | Dallas Detox Center
metaDescription: Meet Haley Wadlington, Director of Client Care at Dallas Detox Center.
paragraphs: Haley Wadlington serves as the Director of Client Care, where she is dedicated to ensuring that each client receives compassionate, individualized, and consistent support throughout their treatment experience. In her role, Haley helps oversee client care coordination, discharge planning, family communication, and ongoing support services to help clients feel seen, heard, and guided during a vulnerable time in their lives.

Haley is passionate about creating a client-centered environment built on dignity, accountability, and meaningful connection. She works closely with clients, families, and the clinical team to help identify needs, reduce barriers, and support a smooth transition into the next appropriate level of care. Her approach emphasizes advocacy, clear communication, and practical support, ensuring that clients are not only cared for during treatment but also prepared for continued success after discharge.

With a strong commitment to ethical care and trauma-informed support, Haley strives to make every client interaction purposeful, respectful, and rooted in hope. Her goal is to help clients and their loved ones feel supported, informed, and empowered as they move forward in their recovery journey.
